Claim tested: IpaH4.5 is a Rab31 GAP via TBC-like dual fingers
Key finding: GAP assay, co-IP, CD-MPR trafficking, Magic Red cathepsin B, intracellular persistence
Context: S. flexneri infection of human cells; in vitro GAP assay
Confidence and limitations: Single lab, single paper, not replicated; full text paywalled so finger residues unverifiable; GAP assays with purified bacterial effectors are artefact-prone

Claim tested: Bacterial dual-finger RabGAPs need not have a TBC fold
Key finding: VirA/EspG-Rab1-GDP-AlF3 structures; 3D architecture distinct from TBC domain
Confidence and limitations: High confidence; means a negative TBC-fold result cannot exclude GAP activity

Claim tested: Bacterial RabGAPs span several unrelated folds and finger chemistries
Key finding: LepB GAP domain uses Arg444 with no essential glutamine; RasGAP-like cis-glutamine mechanism
Confidence and limitations: High confidence; widens the space of possible GAP mechanisms

Supports/refutes/qualifies/competing: refutes TBC-fold version of the hypothesis
Claim tested: Some region of IpaH4.5 adopts a TBC fold
Key finding: 2568 alignments over 5 query regions; 0 TBC/RabGAP hits; reciprocal Gyp1 and VirA searches return 0 IpaH hits
Confidence and limitations: High confidence for the fold question; cannot exclude a novel-fold GAP site

Claim tested: An unassigned region could host a TBC domain
Key finding: 17 member-database matches cover 4-287 (LRR) and 295-574 (NEL); no TBC signature
Confidence and limitations: High confidence

Claim tested: Motif-flagged Arg and Gln form a catalytic pair
Key finding: Closest motif pair 30.1 A vs 3.75-4.25 A in references; 12/1218 Arg-Gln pairs meet geometry by chance
Context: AlphaFold model; AlphaFold side-chain rotamers are approximate
Confidence and limitations: Medium-high; conclusion rests on backbone separation, which is robust to rotamer error

Claim tested: Dual-finger residues are IpaH4.5-specific
Key finding: R429/R433/Q531/Q567 invariant in 12/12 paralogs, like Cys379; R41/Q146 variable (2/12)
Confidence and limitations: High confidence
